codeReview.summary: The implementation satisfies the requested stream-format migration: backend writes _json stream fields, the new lazy streams endpoint is present, TripDetail fetches streams through the endpoint, and legacy stream fallback paths exist. No blocking correctness issue was found in the intended flow.

issues.description: When `latlng_json` exists, parsing assumes `altitude_json`, `time_json`, and `distance_json` are also valid JSON strings. A partially migrated or malformed stream doc would throw during `JSON.parse` and return 500 instead of degrading gracefully.

No feature-specific automated test coverage was added for `/api/activities/:activityId/streams` (lazy Strava fetch + Firestore cache + legacy/json parsing branches), so regressions in this path may be missed by the existing suite.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The fullstack-worker skill procedure requires tests-first and manual interactive verification entries, but this run reported `followedProcedure: true` without those artifacts. This suggests a mismatch between skill expectations and how adherence is evaluated.
